_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products and services, by designing and selling hardware, and by delivering relevant online advertising to a global customer audience'; 'The cloud-based computing model presents execution and competitive risks': 'Our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Challenges to our business models may reduce our revenue or operating margins': 'Certain “open source” software business models challenge our license-based software model'; 'We face intense competition' (its own FY2011 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products and services, by designing and selling hardware, and by delivering relevant online advertising to a global customer audience'; 'The cloud-based computing model presents execution and competitive risks': 'Our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Challenges to our business models may reduce our revenue or operating margins': 'Certain “open source” software business models challenge our license-based software model'; 'We face intense competition' (its own FY2011 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.55x; +8% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.20; conservative 2yr +29%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -24.2%/yr (worst year FY02-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.7%/yr (Q4 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.3%/yr (FY02-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2012-07-20) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.55x (60.2% downside to Bear $12 / +109.2% upside to Bull $63) | Adj composite 2.13 vs market 1.93: gap +0.20 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +8% above the EPP floor $28 (14x FY13E $2.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +29.2% total (+14.6%/yr) | At 15.1x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $40 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; unearned revenue +17.2% in Q4 FY12, forward revenues +4% (no Q1 FY13 revenue guide, Q4 FY12 revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
